chapterTitle: Chapter 4: The Cap Seller and the Monkeys 🧢🐒
learningGoals: Listen to and enjoy a classic folktale together! 📖
Understand the concept of thinking quickly and clever problem-solving. 🧠
Identify and name new animals and everyday objects like caps, monkeys, and trees. 🐵
Follow simple instructions and practice mimicking actions just like the funny monkeys! 🤸‍♂️
teachingTips: Read the story aloud with plenty of expressions and silly voices to keep your little one excited and engaged! 🎭
Pause during the story and ask questions like 'What do you think the monkeys will do next?' to build their prediction skills. 🤔
Help them understand the word 'copy' by asking them to imitate your simple actions, like clapping hands or touching their nose. 👏
Discuss how the cap seller used his clever mind instead of crying or getting angry. It is a wonderful gentle lesson in staying calm! 🧘‍♀️

funActivities.title: Monkey See, Monkey Do! 🐒
funActivities.description: Play a fun imitation game with your child. Make funny faces, stretch your arms, or do silly dances, and ask them to copy you exactly, just like the monkeys in our story.

funActivities.title: Cap Colour Sorting 🔴🟡🔵
funActivities.description: Gather different caps or hats from around your home. Ask your child to sort them by colour or size to help build their observation and grouping skills.

funActivities.title: The Magic Story Basket 🧺
funActivities.description: Place a few safe, everyday items in a small basket. Let your child pull them out one by one and help them make up their very own imaginative short story.
